name: Insider Option – Instagram Congress Trade Poster

parameters.content:
## Setup Checklist

**Env vars to set in n8n:**
- `INSIDER_OPTION_API_URL` — base URL of your Insider Option backend
- `IMAGE_GENERATOR_URL` — URL of the image-generator Render service
- `IG_USER_ID` — Instagram Business Account ID
- `IG_ACCESS_TOKEN` — long-lived Facebook/Instagram access token

**How to get IG credentials:**
1. Create a Facebook Developer App
2. Add Instagram Graph API product
3. Connect your Instagram Business Account
4. Generate a long-lived User Access Token
5. Find your IG User ID via:
   `GET https://graph.facebook.com/me?fields=id&access_token=TOKEN`

**Insider Option API contract:**
The workflow expects `GET /api/trades/congress/latest` to return:
```json
{
  "id": "unique-trade-id",
  "ticker": "NVDA",
  "politician": "Nancy Pelosi",
  "party": "Democrat",
  "type": "Purchase",
  "amount_min": 500000,
  "amount_max": 1000000,
  "trade_date": "2024-01-10",
  "filed_date": "2024-01-15",
  "asset_description": "NVIDIA Corporation"
}
```
